Squash only commits that are part of the same fix.

labels.text: Missing `RESTRICT_ON_SEND` — always define this when using `on_send`.

labels.text: Spec stubs inheriting from `RuboCop::Cop::Cop`: inheriting from the deprecated class emits a warning, and CI runs specs with `STRICT_WARNINGS=1`, which turns it into a failure you won't see locally. Stub cops with `stub_cop_class` on `Base`, and read their offenses from `cop.send(:complete_investigation).offenses`; `Base#offenses` raises by design.
labels.label: true

.github/workflows/rubocop.yml:42 STRICT_WARNINGS: 1
lib/rubocop/rspec/shared_contexts.rb:96 def stub_cop_class(name, inherit: RuboCop::Cop::Base, &block)
lib/rubocop/cop/base.rb:339-341 def offenses raise 'The offenses are not directly available ...'
spec/rubocop/cop/cop_spec.rb:226 cop.send(:complete_investigation).offenses
labels.note: Every element (warning, STRICT_WARNINGS in CI, stub_cop_class, complete_investigation, Base#offenses raising) checks out.

docs/modules/ROOT/pages/versioning.adoc:137 `--only` runs it by name, whether or not preview is on.
labels.note: --only bypasses Enabled/pending/preview checks.
